purpose: Prevent handoff regressions that incorrectly block simulation on non-essential market data.

core_rule.required_operational_output_when_odds_ar: For each candidate ticket, emit the minimum acceptable purchase odds / break-even-or-policy threshold so the Owner can compare against live odds manually at operation time.

minimum_input_principle.rule: Use only information that is necessary to generate the prediction or materially improves predictive performance. Missing non-essential fields must not block simulation.
minimum_input_principle.ablation_definition: Remove or withhold one candidate input class at a time and compare predictive performance. Inputs that do not materially improve performance should remain optional for simulation.
fail_closed_only_for: missing information without which race identity or participant identity cannot be established
untrusted or ambiguous rider identity joins
inputs required by the exact frozen model or selector being evaluated

separation_of_concerns.prediction_research_lane: Generate ranking/probability/ticket candidates from PRE-only race information without requiring odds when the frozen model itself does not require odds.
separation_of_concerns.execution_lane: At actual operation time, compare live odds against the precomputed minimum acceptable odds and buy only if the threshold is met; Owner/manual execution only unless separately authorized.
separation_of_concerns.formal_science_lane: Real odds are still required when the scientific claim being tested is realized profitability/ROI. Their absence must not halt model-learning or prediction-simulation work that does not mathematically depend on them.

handoff_rule.instruction: Any future KEIRIN handoff/resume must preserve this minimum-input separation explicitly. Do not revert to 'wait for odds before simulation'.
